title: Samsung HBM4E wins NVIDIA nod for AI accelerator push
key_facts: Hankyung.com reported Wednesday (7 Oct) that Samsung's 12-layer HBM4E passed qualification tests by Nvidia and major hyperscale customers at the end of September.
Qualification tests check that components meet customer specifications before commercial supply is considered.
The report did not confirm quantities, contract values, delivery schedules or mass-production shipment timing.
quote_evidence: According to a Wednesday report by South Korean news outlet Hankyung.com, Samsung's 12-layer HBM4E memory product passed qualification tests conducted by Nvidia and major hyperscale computing customers at the end of September.
The report did not confirm the quantities of memory chips that Samsung may supply to Nvidia or other customers.
However, the timing and scale of any commercial deliveries remain uncertain until supply agreements and production schedules are confirmed.
why_it_matters_hint: A qualification step for Samsung; not a supply deal.
notes: Digitimes page shows only the lead ('reportedly cleared customer quality validation'); full text read in the Yahoo Finance rewrite, which credits Hankyung.com (Korea Economic Daily). Event (test pass) was end of September, report 7 Oct, so older than the 8 Oct window.
